name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
tagline: Small-cap Ahmedabad B2B antique/bridal gold jewellery manufacturer (strategic vendor to Titan; Malabar, Joyalukkas, Senco, PN Gadgil as clients) now pivoting to own-brand B2C retail in Gujarat. ~29% FY26 ROCE, ~14x P/E, Q1 FY27 revenue +60% YoY (retail +70%, wholesale +47%) — but operating cash flow has been negative three years running and the retail format is unproven
business_overview: Ahmedabad-based designer/manufacturer/distributor of Antique Bridal Gold Jewellery, historically wholesale/job-work to national retail chains (Titan strategic vendor; Malabar, Joyalukkas, Senco, Bhima, Kalamandir, PN Gadgil). ~2 tonnes/year gold-processing capacity, ~250 artisans. Now scaling own large-format retail under its own brand: 4 stores planned FY27 (Surat, Rajkot, Maninagar, Gandhinagar), 7 showrooms across Gujarat over two years, targeting a 50:50 B2B:B2C revenue mix within two years.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 803 Cr (small-cap); price ~Rs 197, P/E ~14x (was ~10.6x on 1-Sep, has re-rated on the Q1 print)
~29% / ~20% FY26 (ROCE recovered from 16.5% FY24 and 33% FY23 — cyclical with gold and mix)
Revenue ~Rs 636 Cr (+20% YoY from ~Rs 530 Cr FY25); PAT ~Rs 54.8 Cr (+41% YoY from ~Rs 38.9 Cr); EBITDA margin ~14.4%
Revenue Rs 120.8 Cr (+60% YoY): retail Rs 78 Cr (+70%), wholesale Rs 42 Cr (+47%). EBITDA Rs 18 Cr (+39%), margin 14.9% vs 16.5% YoY. PAT Rs 9.09 Cr (+28%)
Operating cash flow NEGATIVE three consecutive years: -Rs 11 Cr FY23, -Rs 48 Cr FY24, -Rs 14 Cr FY25 — profits absorbed by gold inventory / working capital
~Rs 140 Cr borrowings; D/E <1, target 0.8 by year-end; Rs 300 Cr gold-metal-loan (GML) facility sanctioned at 3-3.5% to hedge inventory and cut interest cost
fundamentals_narrative: Headline returns are strong (FY26 ROCE ~29%, ROE ~20%) and growth has genuinely accelerated — FY26 revenue +20%, Q1 FY27 +60% with both legs firing (retail +70%, wholesale +47%). Valuation is undemanding at ~14x trailing. The two real reservations: (1) operating cash flow has been negative for three straight years as reported profit is absorbed into gold inventory and receivables — the newly sanctioned Rs 300 Cr GML facility is management's answer, and whether it works is thesis-relevant; (2) the B2C own-store push is a new, marketing-intensive game versus the established B2B wholesale model, and only 4 stores are planned for FY27. FY24 was also a stumble (PAT -3.4%, ROCE down to 16.5%), so the track record is short and uneven. Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin dipped 160bps YoY on store pre-opening costs and stagnant gold prices.
technical_read: Stock has re-rated hard: 52-week range ~Rs 100-205, currently near the high ~Rs 197. Not independently charted this pass.
sentiment_summary: VP thread (topic 188519, only 3 posts, opened Mar 2025, no activity since) is essentially a company-overview post (love: 9) followed immediately by a reply flagging that 'detailed risk analysis, financials & disclosure of your holding is missing.' No further discussion followed — the thread never developed into real diligence.
community_signal: Minimal — one well-received overview post established the interesting B2B-wholesale angle, but a legitimate call for deeper risk/financial disclosure went unanswered and the thread went dormant.
bse_notes: No SEBI/fraud order; no going-concern issue found. No red_flag_tier. 18th AGM scheduled 10-Sep-2026.
bull_case: B2B wholesale/job-work to major national chains (Titan strategic vendor, plus Malabar/Joyalukkas/Senco/Bhima/PN Gadgil) is structurally different from direct-to-consumer jewellery competition — a base business funding the retail optionality
~29% FY26 ROCE and accelerating growth (Q1 FY27 revenue +60% YoY, broad-based across retail and wholesale) at ~Rs 800 Cr size, on an undemanding ~14x P/E
GML facility (Rs 300 Cr sanctioned at 3-3.5%) directly targets the working-capital / interest-cost drag and should improve cash conversion and lower finance costs
FY27 own-store rollout (Surat, Rajkot, Maninagar, Gandhinagar) plus a stated 50:50 B2B:B2C target is a credible second growth leg if executed; 18-carat mix push aids realisation
Gold at all-time highs is a demand and inventory-value tailwind for a gold-inventory jeweller
bear_case: Operating cash flow negative three consecutive years (-Rs 11 / -Rs 48 / -Rs 14 Cr FY23-25) — reported PAT is not converting to cash; the whole thesis leans on the GML strategy fixing this
Near-zero independent VP community diligence; the one call for detailed risk/financial disclosure was never answered
B2C own-store retail is a new, marketing- and location-intensive model with different execution risk than the established wholesale business; only 4 stores planned FY27
Short, uneven track record: listed ~2 years; FY24 saw PAT -3.4% and ROCE fall to 16.5% before the FY25-26 recovery
Gujarat-concentrated as it expands into owned retail; working-capital-heavy, gold-price-exposed balance sheet — inventory financing risk in a sharp gold reversal
Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin -160bps YoY; PAT growth (+28%) well below revenue (+60%)

four_box.note: tailwind yes — structural wedding-jewellery demand + formalisation + gold at highs, a live multi-year driver. tam weak — for a 10x off ~Rs 800 Cr the required revenue base (multi-thousand Cr) is a long road for a 4-store Gujarat regional player; near-term the wholesale ceiling with a handful of large clients isn't demonstrated to be that large. moat weak — B2B-to-major-retailers positioning and antique/temple design capability are real differentiators but not evidenced pricing power. valuation yes — ~14x trailing for ~30-40% recent earnings growth and ~29% ROCE genuinely leaves room to pay (caveat: reported PAT has not been converting to operating cash, so a cash-aware investor haircuts). Score 3.0 -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted; also supported by the small/mid-cap live-inflection rule (Q1 FY27 revenue +60% YoY plus dated FY27 store catalysts). Conviction held at Low-Medium on the negative-CFO and unproven-retail caveats.

verdict_reasoning: External-lead (tier 4.5, @StocksAndStoics). four_box score 3.0 (tailwind yes, valuation yes, tam/moat weak) -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted; also reinforced by the small/mid-cap live-inflection interaction rule — a real recent-quarter inflection (Q1 FY27 revenue +60% YoY, broad-based) plus dated FY27 catalysts (Surat/Rajkot store launches).

Conviction held at Low-Medium, not upgraded. The deep read verified the strong ROCE and reasonable valuation, but also surfaced negative operating cash flow for three straight years (profit absorbed into gold inventory), a short and uneven listed track record (FY24 PAT -3.4%, ROCE 16.5%), a 160bps YoY margin dip in Q1 FY27, and an unproven B2C retail format. The GML strategy is the right fix but is not yet shown to work.
No red_flag_tier (the cash-flow issue is inventory build, not fraud/going-concern). No revisit flag (conviction below the Medium-High threshold).

Re-verify at H1 FY27: does operating cash flow turn positive as GML replaces working-capital borrowing, do the first own-stores open on schedule and generate the guided economics, and does the PAT-vs-revenue growth gap close.

annual_report_findings: Operating cash flow negative three consecutive years: -Rs 11 Cr FY23, -Rs 48 Cr FY24, -Rs 14 Cr FY25 — reported profits absorbed into gold inventory and receivables; this is the single most important offset to the headline ~29% ROCE.
Returns are cyclical: ROCE 33% FY23 -> 16.5% FY24 -> ~29% FY26; FY24 also had PAT -3.4% YoY. Track record is short (listed ~2 years) and uneven.
FY25 revenue ~Rs 530 Cr, PAT ~Rs 38.9 Cr; FY26 revenue ~Rs 636 Cr (+20%), PAT ~Rs 54.8 Cr (+41%), EBITDA margin ~14.4%.

Balance sheet is working-capital-heavy (~Rs 140 Cr borrowings) as normal for a gold-inventory jeweller; D/E <1 with a stated 0.8 target and a Rs 300 Cr GML facility to convert expensive working-capital debt into cheap (3-3.5%) gold loans and hedge price risk.
Promoter holding 75%, no pledge; small dividend initiated.
Client base skews to large national chains (Titan strategic vendor) on wholesale/job-work — a genuine structural difference from consumer-facing listed jewellers.

Q4 FY26 (Mar-26): net sales ~Rs 189 Cr (+38% YoY); flagged as a sequential decline vs Q3 with margin concerns

recent_announcements: Aug 2026: Q1 FY27 results + earnings call — retail-led 60% revenue growth, GML strategy detailed, 4-store FY27 plan (Surat, Rajkot, Maninagar, Gandhinagar)
Aug 2026: Rs 300 Cr gold-metal-loan facility sanctioned at 3-3.5% for inventory hedging and expansion
Nothing else material (no fund-raise, rating action, litigation, or governance change found)
key_new_facts: Operating cash flow has been negative for three straight years — the headline ROCE overstates cash economics.
Growth in Q1 FY27 is broad-based (retail +70% AND wholesale +47%), not a single-line spike.
GML facility (Rs 300 Cr at 3-3.5%) is a concrete plan to fix the working-capital drag and cut finance costs.
Valuation ~14x trailing is undemanding for the growth/return profile; stock has already re-rated from ~10.6x on 1-Sep.
FY24 was a genuine down year (PAT -3.4%, ROCE 16.5%) — the recovery is only two years old.
open_questions: Does operating cash flow turn positive as the GML facility replaces working-capital borrowing? This is the crux.
Do the FY27 own-stores open on schedule and hit the guided store economics, or does B2C marketing spend keep compressing margin?
Is the Q1 FY27 PAT-vs-revenue growth gap (28% vs 60%) purely pre-opening cost / gold timing, or structural mix dilution?
How defensible is the Titan/Malabar wholesale relationship — pricing power, or a replaceable job-worker?
track_record: only FY26 is cleanly verifiable as clearing both the growth and ROCE bar; FY23-25 are partial and FY24 failed.
deep_dive.conviction_update: Low-Medium -> Low-Medium. Deep read confirmed strong FY26 ROCE (~29%), accelerating broad-based growth and an undemanding ~14x multiple, keeping the four_box at 3.0 and the 10x-in-2-3-years label. But it also surfaced negative operating cash flow three years running, a short uneven track record (FY24 stumble), and an unproven B2C retail pivot — so conviction is held, not upgraded, pending evidence the GML strategy converts profit to cash and the stores execute.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Revenue YoY: ~flat FY24-ish base, FY25 recovery, FY26 +20%, Q4 FY26 +38%, Q1 FY27 +60% — clearly accelerating on the retail push. PAT YoY: FY24 -3.4%, FY25 ~+39%, FY26 +41%, Q1 FY27 +28% (lagged revenue on mix + store pre-opening cost).
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~14x trailing for ~30-40% recent earnings growth and ~29% ROCE is undemanding; the multiple needs only ~13% growth, so the rate-of-change is well ahead of what the price requires. Main watch is cash conversion, not the multiple.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvesting into gold inventory and own-store retail; company-level ROCE strong (~29% FY26) but operating cash flow negative three years running, so growth has been working-capital/debt-funded. The GML pivot is an explicit attempt to fix this.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit move up the chain: B2B job-work -> own-brand B2C large-format retail, plus a push into higher-realisation 18-carat product.

track_record.note: FY24-FY26 assessable. FY26 clears both (revenue +20%, ROCE ~29%). FY25 revenue growth vs FY24 not precisely verified this pass though PAT +39% and rising ROCE suggest a likely clear. FY24 fails (PAT -3.4%, ROCE fell to 16.5%). track_record.caveat: Only one year (FY26) is cleanly verified as clearing both bars; treat consistency as unproven.
